# Starbloom Consulting LLC - Edge AI & Automation Orchestration Platform

> Starbloom Consulting LLC is the Apex Edge AI & Automation Orchestration Platform. Private AI infrastructure on your hardware. Pre-configured n8n appliances, 24/7 AI voice & SMS intake engines, and legacy data bridge agents. Apex Founders Circle - limited slots available.

## Product Tiers

- **Apex Core Foundation** ($229/mo): n8n automation server, 2 autonomous AI agents, 5 workflow automations, BigQuery + Looker Studio, Ollama fleet manager
- **Apex Core Fleet** ($299/mo): Everything in Foundation + 24/7 AI voice & SMS intake, legacy data bridge, unlimited workflows, up to 2 machines
- **Apex Signal Agency** ($149/mo): Multi-source reconnaissance (Grok + DeepSeek + Perplexity), weekly market briefs, OODA-loop automation
- **AEO Reports** ($29/mo): AI-powered weekly content corpus (5 articles, 10 LinkedIn posts, X thread, 8 carousel slides)

## Trust & Confidentiality

- Every deployment operates inside the client's private infrastructure - behind their firewall, on their hardware
- All tunnel traffic is encrypted end-to-end via Cloudflare Zero Trust architecture
- Zero inbound ports architecture
- Mutual NDA required on every engagement
- We do not name clients, publish logos, or ask for testimonials
- The ultimate test subject was Starbloom itself (Patient Zero case study)
